note: Verbatim messages shown to users. Not medical advice. {emergency_number} is replaced at runtime from the EMERGENCY_NUMBER environment variable.

emergency.heading: This sounds like an emergency.
emergency.body: Based on what you have described, you need emergency help right now. Please call {emergency_number} immediately or ask someone nearby to call for you. Do not drive yourself. Stay on the line with the operator — they will tell you what to do while help is on the way.
emergency.additional_note: If you cannot call, text 999 (UK) or ask anyone nearby to help you.
emergency.do_not_wait_reason: Delaying emergency care can be life-threatening.

urgent.heading: You should be seen today.
urgent.body: What you have described needs attention today. Please contact an urgent care centre, your GP surgery for a same-day appointment, or call {emergency_number} if things get worse quickly. Do not wait more than a few hours.
urgent.escalation_prompt: If you feel significantly worse, or develop any of the following — difficulty breathing, chest pain, loss of consciousness — call {emergency_number} straight away.

needs_human_review.heading: We could not confirm a match.
needs_human_review.body: We were not able to find a service we are confident is right for your situation after checking twice. Please call your GP surgery or dial {emergency_number} if you are worried. A person can help you better here.

handoff_intro.heading: Share a summary?
handoff_intro.body: Would you like a short summary of this conversation to share with a healthcare professional? It will include what you described and the service we suggested — nothing more.

handoff_declined.body: No summary created. You can always come back if you need help again.

disclaimer.body: CareCompass helps you find local services. It does not provide medical advice or diagnose conditions. Always follow the guidance of a qualified healthcare professional.
